findings.detail: PermitRootLogin is 'yes (default)'. Set 'PermitRootLogin no' in sshd_config.
PasswordAuthentication is 'yes (default)'. Set 'PasswordAuthentication no' and use key-based auth only.
MaxAuthTries is '6 (default)'. Recommend 3-4 to slow brute force.
X11Forwarding is 'yes'. Disable unless explicitly needed.
